purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current viewer-route outcomes, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: The official Liuyang government portal identifies a local Natural Resources Bureau and the official Hunan Tianditu portal lists Liuyang as an available map area. Direct bounded retrieval did not yield current viewer configuration or a safe anonymous parcel feature response.
registryAssessment: A local government department is evidenced, but no Liuyang-specific cadastral or real-estate-registration procedure was verified in this attempt; registryFound remains null.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Liuyang government portal; its department/service navigation identifies the Liuyang Natural Resources Bureau. No parcel geometry was exposed in the inspected page result.
Official Hunan Tianditu public portal; the inspected result lists 浏阳市 (Liuyang) among selectable Hunan city/county areas. No parcel schema or geometry response was exposed.
Official Tianditu API documentation; it states that the documented search services require an application key. This is general API documentation, not evidence of a Liuyang cadastral parcel layer.
